# taller.sh

> Software engineering workshop specializing in bespoke intelligence infrastructure, production runtime clusters, and tested architecture blueprints.

## Core Offerings

- [Engineering Manifesto](https://taller.sh/manifesto.html): Principles of deterministic software engineering, zero-fluff delivery, and sovereign infrastructure.
- [Validated Architecture Blueprints](https://taller.sh/#blueprints): Production-ready architecture blueprints including event streaming, private vector RAG, workflow orchestration, and resilient microservices.
- [Bespoke Intelligence Clusters](https://taller.sh/#contact): Turnkey private intelligence clusters, on-premise hardware provisioning, and managed dedicated cloud operations.
- [Client Validations & Case Studies](https://taller.sh/#benchmarks): Verified performance audits, throughput benchmarks, and latency reductions.

## Architectural Principles

- **Zero Middleware Theater**: No unnecessary proxies, no vendor lock-in. Clean, inspectable architectures.
- **Sovereign Computing**: Deploy to bare metal, private cloud VPCs, or sovereign European infrastructure with rigorous privacy guarantees.
- **Continuous Validation**: Every blueprint and cluster is validated under adversarial load and verified with end-to-end telemetry.
